title: Independent Living Residency Agreement — Article on One Agreement per Customer and Exclusivity with Care Residences
content:
## Article 1 — One agreement at a time

1.1 A customer holds at most 1 Independent Living Residency Agreement at a time. A second occupant sharing the apartment is recorded on the same agreement and never opens an agreement of their own.

1.2 A new reservation may be opened only when the customer has no other independent living residency in reserved, active or notice given status.

1.3 Independent living and Larkspur care residences are mutually exclusive for the same person. A new reservation may be opened only when the customer has no assisted living residency in pending admission, active, on leave or notice given status and no memory care residency in pending admission, active, on leave or notice given status.

1.4 A customer whose prior residency is vacated, closed or cancelled may reserve again; the earlier residency keeps its own ledger and final statement.

## Basis of judgement

Both conditions in 1.2 and 1.3 are read from the system records for the customer — the customer's independent living residencies and their statuses, and the customer's assisted living and memory care residencies and their statuses — at the moment the new reservation would be opened. A new reservation is a separate record; it is the presence of another record in one of the listed statuses that bars it.

| Customer's existing records | A new independent living reservation may be opened? |
|---|---|
| An independent living residency in reserved, active or notice given status | No |
| An assisted living residency in pending admission, active, on leave or notice given status | No |
| A memory care residency in pending admission, active, on leave or notice given status | No |
| Only independent living residencies that are vacated, closed or cancelled, and no care residency in a status listed above | Yes |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A resident whose earlier independent living residency was closed after a move-out, and who holds no care residency in a listed status, may reserve a new apartment; the closed residency keeps its own ledger and final statement.
- A spouse moving into the apartment of a resident is recorded as the second occupant on the resident's existing agreement rather than opening an agreement.
